left.issue: Klotski: the other name labels (Zhang Fei, Guan Yu, Zhao Yun, about 0.57-0.78) stay small: they fill the narrow coloured strips of their tiles and cannot grow without covering the faces. The 'Soldier' labels (p50_a1/a2/a3) sit in EMPTY cells next to the soldier tiles, which could make readers think a piece is there; the tiles' own strips are too narrow for the word.
